# Q.E.D. (Quod Erat Demonstrandum)
> The High-Assurance Engineering Framework for Autonomous Coding Agents

## Core Principles
- Evidence Before Assertions: No code claims without verified terminal test execution.
- Root Cause Only: Ban on empty catch blocks, fake timeouts, and loose type casts.
- Dual Execution Modes: Production (Quality > Speed) by default; Prototype (Speed > Quality) on-demand.
- Blast Radius: Calculate direct callers and indirect API/DB side-effects before editing shared code.
- Anti-Duplication: Search repository before creating new helpers, types, or hooks.
- 4 Mandatory States: Empty, Loading, Error (actionable with retry), and Degraded states.
- The 3 AM Test: Flat guard clauses, early returns, clear intermediate variables.
- Chaos Monkey: Adversarial tests for rapid double-clicks, oversized payloads, and hostile Unicode.
